title: 多模干涉分光器
summary: 以多模自成像、分光平衡與複數 S 參數為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Multimode self-imaging, split balance and complex S-parameters, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

steps.title: 建立模態疊加：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Build a modal superposition: model and design
steps.objective: 建立建立模態疊加的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for build a modal superposition.
steps.instruction: 先標出「建立模態疊加」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。多模區內不同傳播常數累積相位差，在特定長度重建一個或多個像。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for build a modal superposition. Modes with different propagation constants accumulate phase differences and recreate one or more images at selected lengths. Compare at least two design states and write a prediction that measurement could falsify. Review the relevant interfaces with the mentor view and preserve assumptions and unknown parameters.
steps.observation: 畫至少三個模態的相位演進，檢查輸出位置。
steps.observationEn: Plot phase evolution of at least three modes and inspect image positions.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「MMI 就是把光當水平均分岔」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "An MMI simply splits light like a fluid junction" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交建立模態疊加的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：畫至少三個模態的相位演進，檢查輸出位置。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for build a modal superposition: Plot phase evolution of at least three modes and inspect image positions. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.

knowledge.textEn: Modes with different propagation constants accumulate phase differences and recreate one or more images at selected lengths.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 畫至少三個模態的相位演進，檢查輸出位置。 不可推成：MMI 就是把光當水平均分岔
knowledge.textEn: Plot phase evolution of at least three modes and inspect image positions. Do not infer: An MMI simply splits light like a fluid junction

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假想 1 mW 輸入，兩輸出為 0.46、0.44 mW，總傳輸 0.90，過量損耗 −10log10(0.90)=0.458 dB；不平衡 10log10(0.46/0.44)=0.193 dB。理想均分每路 3.010 dB 是功率分配，不是 3.010 dB 的過量損耗。 自成像近似只提供初估，需以足夠模態、正確端口和波長掃描驗證；數值收斂與實物校準是不同工作。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical 1 mW input and 0.46/0.44 mW outputs, total transmission is 0.90, excess loss 0.458 dB and imbalance 0.193 dB. The ideal 3.010 dB per branch is power division, not excess loss. Self-imaging approximations give initial estimates; verify sufficient modes, correct ports and wavelength sweeps. Numerical convergence differs from physical calibration.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「多模干涉分光器」的「建立模態疊加：模型與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「光引擎：把訊號接回來」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Build a modal superposition: model and design” in “Multimode-interference splitters”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Optical Engine: Restore the Signal” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.titleEn: Separate division and loss: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 用區分分光與損耗的量測證據區分競爭解釋。
steps.objectiveEn: Use measurements of separate division and loss to distinguish competing explanations.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，執行下列資料判讀：重算 0.458 dB 過量損耗並核對兩路和。 將原始量、單位、量測參考面與重複性分欄記錄；比較預測與觀察，說明能排除「每路少一半代表元件吸收一半」的直接證據，再決定接受、重測或修模。 假想 1 mW 輸入，兩輸出為 0.46、0.44 mW，總傳輸 0.90，過量損耗 −10log10(0.90)=0.458 dB；不平衡 10log10(0.46/0.44)=0.193 dB。理想均分每路 3.010 dB 是功率分配，不是 3.010 dB 的過量損耗。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and perform this data review: Recalculate 0.458 dB excess loss and verify the output sum. Record raw values, units, reference planes and repeatability separately. Compare prediction with observation and identify direct evidence rejecting "Half power per branch means half is absorbed" before accepting, remeasuring or revising. With hypothetical 1 mW input and 0.46/0.44 mW outputs, total transmission is 0.90, excess loss 0.458 dB and imbalance 0.193 dB. The ideal 3.010 dB per branch is power division, not excess loss.
steps.observation: 重算 0.458 dB 過量損耗並核對兩路和。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate 0.458 dB excess loss and verify the output sum.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「每路少一半代表元件吸收一半」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Half power per branch means half is absorbed" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交區分分光與損耗的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：重算 0.458 dB 過量損耗並核對兩路和。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for separate division and loss: Recalculate 0.458 dB excess loss and verify the output sum. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.
